entries.reason: An engineering run's reads (only with -c engineeringAgents=true) are administrators-only until a connection can be shared, so they have no MCP tool (a token is never an admin), and the SPA's run monitor that will call them is phase 5 (docs/autonomous-engineering.md); until then an administrator reads them over REST.
